correctness.rationale: Re-derived Hall equivalence for r<=3: each server pair U contains at most two fully supported items. Summing all six pair inequalities gives 3a1+a2<=12; combined with seven items forces excess storage >=5. At equality a1=a3+2a4+2, and disjoint singleton supports force precisely profiles (3,3,1,0),(2,5,0,0). The former consists of one three-subset and star pairs to a fourth server (16 cases); the latter of two singleton items and five pairs with unique allowable multiplicities (30 cases). A NEW independent finite enumeration of all 116280 multisets found 39112 Hall-valid codes, 46 storage-12 optima, S4 orbit sizes 4,6,12,24, and 171360 fully labeled assignments. Both known optimum and equality numbers checked; finite enumeration genuinely exhausts this finite parameter only.
